guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合為主線，從總磷與溶解磷、厭氧選擇區、可利用碳與磷比例、厭氧釋磷觀察進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting through ten connected units, beginning with total and dissolved phosphorus, anaerobic selection zone, available carbon-to-p balance, anaerobic release observation. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「總磷與溶解磷」的觀測點。對照總磷消化分析與過濾樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「厭氧選擇區」的觀測點。把分區入口與出口示蹤時間畫成圖。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「可利用碳與磷比例」的觀測點。將 VFA、可快速降解 COD 與正磷酸鹽一起採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「厭氧釋磷觀察」的觀測點。依流動延遲配對入口與出口採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「好氧吸磷」的觀測點。同時追蹤水相 P 與污泥含磷率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「富磷排泥」的觀測點。稱重乾固體後分析 P，與水線進出量閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「硝酸鹽入侵」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「顆粒磷逃逸」的觀測點。比較過濾前後總磷與 TSS。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「污泥齡折衷」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「全廠磷閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total and dissolved phosphorus. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic selection zone. Plot tracer arrival at the compartment inlet and outlet. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for available carbon-to-p balance. Sample VFA, readily biodegradable COD and orthophosphate together. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic release observation. Pair inlet and outlet samples using the hydraulic delay. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for aerobic uptake. Track aqueous P and sludge P content simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus-rich wasting. Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrate intrusion. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particulate phosphorus escape. Compare filtered/unfiltered phosphorus with TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-age trade-off. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-plant phosphorus closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只量正磷酸鹽會漏算顆粒磷。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。
內回流夾帶硝酸鹽破壞選擇作用。診斷與介入：查分隔牆與旁流，將有效容積重新列入區段模型。
把難分解 COD 算入有效供碳。診斷與介入：分析 VFA 及可快速分解 COD，區分可利用比例。
只憑釋磷判定全廠磷已去除。診斷與介入：按水力延遲配對採樣，檢查硝酸鹽和氧入侵。
吸磷後不排泥會讓磷留在系統。診斷與介入：把吸磷與含磷排泥一起檢查，不只比水相濃度。
濕泥重量造成固體與磷高估。診斷與介入：重算乾固體與乾基含磷率，將濕重和元素質量分開。
只調曝氣而不追蹤回流硝酸鹽。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。
只優化菌相而忽略沉澱與過濾。診斷與介入：比較過濾前後磷與 TSS，優先診斷固體逃逸。
排泥過低使磷出口不足。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。
無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
pitfallsEn: Orthophosphate alone misses particulate phosphorus. Diagnostic response: Remeasure total/dissolved P and diagnose solids separation separately from aqueous reactions.
Nitrate carryover undermines selection. Diagnostic response: Check baffles and bypass streams and update the compartment effective volume.
Refractory COD is counted as effective carbon. Diagnostic response: Analyze VFA/readily biodegradable COD to distinguish availability.
Release alone is mistaken for plant removal. Diagnostic response: Pair samples by hydraulic lag and check nitrate/oxygen intrusion.
Without wasting, phosphorus remains in the system. Diagnostic response: Check uptake together with P-rich wasting, not aqueous concentration alone.
Wet mass overstates solids and phosphorus. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry solids and dry-basis P content separately from wet mass.
Changing aeration alone misses recycle nitrate. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
Optimizing biology while neglecting separation leaves P losses. Diagnostic response: Compare filtered/unfiltered P and TSS, first diagnosing solids escape.
Insufficient wasting restricts P export. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

courses.connection: 本課以厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合為主線，從總磷與溶解磷、厭氧選擇區、可利用碳與磷比例、厭氧釋磷觀察進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting through ten connected units, beginning with total and dissolved phosphorus, anaerobic selection zone, available carbon-to-p balance, anaerobic release observation. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
